global_options.description: Optional global options (e.g., `auto_https off`, `admin off`) for the Caddy server instance.

sites.description: List of site blocks (virtual hosts or address directives). Each defines a domain, path, or port to serve.

comment.description: Optional human-readable comment describing this site block (included as comment in config).

root.description: Root filesystem path for file serving (e.g., `/var/www/example`); applies to all requests under this site.

index.description: Filename to serve as index (e.g., `index.html`), enables `try_files` fallback.

tls.description: TLS configuration for HTTPS. If omitted, automatic Let's Encrypt is used.

email.description: Email for Let’s Encrypt / ACME registration (used only if cert/key not provided).

cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (for manual cert).

key.description: Path to TLS private key file (for manual cert).

options.description: Handler-specific options as key-value pairs (values may contain multi-line content).

rewrite.description: Simple rewrite rule — redirects all requests to a target path.

log.description: Access logging configuration for this site.

path.description: File path where access logs are written (e.g., `/var/log/caddy/example.log`).

format.description: Log format preset (e.g., `json`, `common`) or custom format string.

errors.description: Custom error pages by HTTP status code (e.g., `404 /errors/404.html`).
